evidence: User reported repeated dependence on one guide chat for planning/integration and wanted generic /wc workers to embody guide/analyst/rescate roles.
diagnosis: Routine cognition and routing still had a single-chat choke point: execution workers could return useful evidence, but planning/integration/rescate often waited for the human to reopen or prompt the main guide.
intervention: Created a durable distributed-guide protocol, upgraded /wc to v3.7 so any generic worker can claim GUIDE_INTEGRATOR/GUIDE_PLANNER/GUIDE_RESCATE/GUIDE_CRITIC/GUIDE_STEWARD work, upgraded /g to consume distributed-guide receipts, and seeded three immediately claimable guide jobs for throughput rescue, return integration and frontier replenishment.
tests: GitHub CAS/update writes succeeded for wc and g.
All three guide jobs were created append-only on main.
remaining_boundary: Distributed guide behavior is implemented but not yet proven end-to-end. Need fresh /wc evidence showing at least one worker claims a guide job, writes a guide receipt, materializes useful successors and re-enters allocation without requiring this chat. Automatic chat invocation remains external/unproven.
